integrity.computational_scope: 2,200 random parameter settings and numerical limiting cases; numerical testing is not proof of all quantifiers.
integrity.mathematical_claim: Unique Fisher-optimal time split and its sharp long- and short-horizon information efficiencies; analytic proof supplemented by seeded numerical checks.

scientific_limitations: Applies to ideal independent Poisson events with intensity K/(c+t) for a known exponent of one, positive nuisance amplitude, and locally specified c.
No claim for ETAS dependence, varying detection efficiency, background rate, misspecified time-offset, or adaptive observation boundaries.
Quantifies Fisher information rather than finite-sample estimation performance; possible domination by an unlocated general quantizer theorem remains an originality risk.
title: Sharp two-window Fisher design for inverse-time aftershock counts
